segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling. मैं मीरा बोल रही हूँ. How may I help you?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: मेरा order अभी तक नहीं आया and nobody shared an update.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Delay के लिए I am sorry. Please अपना order reference confirm कर दीजिए.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Order number ओ आर डी two zero four eight है.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you. Delivery कल scheduled है and I will send an SMS confirmation.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That works, मेरी problem solve हो गई. Thank you.
